approval.scope: approved complete-candidate v1 pure validator; HTTP/auth/publication/deployment remain separate gates

entries.summary: Added a CommonJS transport-neutral checker with a fixed in-memory TypeScript host, bundled pinned declarations/libs, source-only AST/type analysis, Data Event and calculation profiles, literal field/hook checks, repeatable scope, bounded outcomes, and version provenance.
Added the ./checker subpath without replacing main dist/expressions.js; moved the existing TypeScript dependency to runtime dependencies because the checker export requires it.

Added tests for deployable JavaScript, TypeScript-only syntax, unknown/dynamic fields, calculation restrictions, repeatable scope, nonexecution, module isolation, limits, nullable variables, redaction, and version provenance.
No runtime.coffee, functions.coffee, generated production bundle, or browser asset was changed.

yarn build, yarn test, frozen-lockfile install, and targeted checker tests passed. make types generated dist/api.raw.d.ts but could not complete script/build.rb because the configured Ruby 3.2.0 asdf tool was unavailable; checked-in ts/api.ts was restored unchanged.
